scope: 空中入口一次支付当前闪身账户，世界竖直位移、历史中心10米敌我分流、伤害与共享Jolt/Amplified；捕获所选闪身收益并复用真实装填/近战回能规则；Utility Kickstart与Powerful Attraction实际职业物品组合。
acceptance: 地面、空职业槽、余额不足和缺失校准拒绝；实际支付与技能信用分离，顶到天花板仍保留已观察的施放效果。
十米包含端点、盟友排除伤害、原始中心不随上升移动、真实生命损失、状态授权拒绝和原有Amplified移动投影。
Marksman实际装备弹匣/备弹转移，Gambler延迟两充能收益；施放后换槽或清槽不替换已接受的收益、不重做闪身位移或支付。
核心混合目标分类、Class属性校准、共享Jolt首击计数、未知动作停机及检查点恢复；组合职业物品先由Kickstart消费充能，再逐球按当前缺口补充。
Marksman共享15米原始弹药砖拾取；上升后当前位置包含端点，后续清槽仍保留已提交换弹，详见marksman-ammo研究。
policies: Capture feet position and both damage snapshots before Ascension movement, when the accepted action body starts. Apply collision-resolved vertical displacement before effects. An observed zero/clipped move qualifies; missing/rejected movement stops the body without refund. Exact animation timing and explosion center need calibration.

The declaration uses captured cost_ability to choose a shared Marksman reload or Gambler melee-return bundle. It does not recast the donor ability or inherit its horizontal motion/tracking animation. The captured branch survives later selection changes; the delayed benefit still reads the current weapon/melee recipient as the original shared rule does.

Grant the shared Amplified template to self and allied candidates; query enemies independently. Apply Jolt through host authorization after direct damage, before queued hit reactions settle. The existing Jolt therefore counts this initial explosion once and may emit its normal chain damage. Damage/status ordering is an explicit Chorus policy pending original-game calibration.

Guardian classification comes from each observed target, not merely the activity mode. Missing/dead targets are skipped; status rejection does not cancel the damage. Known damage outcomes retain independent status authorization, while unknown outcomes stop the runtime.

Utility Kickstart now checks the captured accepted class-ability definition, so an air-move entry can qualify. Its payment and Armor Charge requirements remain; it grants energy to the current class slot. Powerful Attraction retains its existing sequential claim and original Orb rewards.
Marksman now declares its external gain profile and source-documented CES 1. The empty stat stage is an identity path; the actual Class-stat gain curve is still uncalibrated.
The shared Marksman bundle also collects ammo bricks at the current post-displacement caster position before its positive-delay reload; ordering and range anchor remain calibration policies.
gaps: 3米碰撞位移、0.2秒收益延迟、Guardian伤害7及其无额外Class倍率均为合成校准；原作竖直速度/高度、动画时点、PvP伤害与Class曲线、范围衰减、伤害单位投影仍未确定。
181是表格最大战员伤害，当前10米内统一采用该最大值；100–200 Class线性插值只在校准夹具，原表/Clarity仅支持65%上限。共享Amplified 15秒及Jolt 10/5秒沿用现有状态模板，来源特例和完整缩放待校准。
初次爆炸会进入新Jolt的计数；该时序、免疫/取消/致死的状态资格、范围内先后死亡和多个Jolt连锁的原作边界仍需校准。
Arc Staff内重复Ascension的超能支付尚未实现；Acrobat’s Dodge等其余职业技能收益、Winter’s Shroud及完整金装/碎片/模组交互待接线。Marksman拾取已接共享收益，但原作拾取中心/时序待校准；闪身追踪/瞄准辅助规避窗口未作为Ascension收益继承，需独立原作证据。
参考定义仍在测试资源；正式Aspect/子职业目录、装备约束、空中动作键位/UI/动画/素材、物理世界跨重启恢复尚未完成。纯领域检查点不代表世界持久化。
